controls.requirement_title: All production cloud accounts must use
controls.requirement_text: All production cloud accounts must use multi-factor authentication for privileged access.
controls.source_text: All production cloud accounts must use multi-factor authentication for privileged access.

controls.requirement_title: Shared administrator accounts must not be
controls.requirement_text: Shared administrator accounts must not be used.
controls.source_text: Shared administrator accounts must not be used.

controls.requirement_title: Access rights must be reviewed at
controls.requirement_text: Access rights must be reviewed at least quarterly.
controls.source_text: Access rights must be reviewed at least quarterly.

controls.requirement_title: Securityrelevant events must be centrally logged
controls.requirement_text: Security-relevant events must be centrally logged and retained for at least 180 days.
controls.source_text: Security-relevant events must be centrally logged and retained for at least 180 days.

controls.requirement_title: Alerting must be enabled for unauthorized
controls.requirement_text: Alerting must be enabled for unauthorized access attempts and critical configuration changes.
controls.source_text: Alerting must be enabled for unauthorized access attempts and critical configuration changes.

controls.requirement_title: Sensitive data stored in cloud services
controls.requirement_text: Sensitive data stored in cloud services must be encrypted at rest.
controls.source_text: Sensitive data stored in cloud services must be encrypted at rest.

controls.requirement_title: Sensitive data transmitted between services must
controls.requirement_text: Sensitive data transmitted between services must be encrypted in transit.
